prefix._comment: compose = KV concat (prefix_concat.py). Prompt-learning trains slowly and stores facts in soft tokens only -> method-standard high lr + longer schedule (recorded, not recipe-matched).

vera._comment: compose = elementwise mean of vera_lambda_* in the SHARED frozen basis. target_modules restricted to uniform-shape 2048->2048 projections (1B GQA makes k/v 2048->512; peft VeRA shares one A/B buffer). projection_prng_key fixed so every shard sees the same basis; save_projection so composed dirs are self-contained.

ia3._comment: compose = mean of gate vectors (arith primary / geo secondary in compose_peft.py). Paper-standard placement: k/v attention gates + ff gate; feedforward_modules must be a subset of target_modules.

dora._comment: additive CONTROL arm: LoRA+DoRA at the frozen-recipe shape, non-rslora so a 1/N merge is a true mean. Composed via the existing LoRA additive path ONLY if peft accepts DoRA in add_weighted_adapter (CPU probe gates this; magnitude vectors make weight-space averaging semantically lossy either way - recorded caveat).
